Messages.Author: Deckardx
Messages.Body: Do i need to block in order to play obedience if someone rushes me?

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
No. You play Obedience when your reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an acting younger vampire.

Obedience
Reaction
Dominate
Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an acting younger vampire.
